channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Potbelly: BOGO 50% Off: Pastrami Reuben or Pastrami and Swiss
item.guid: Potbelly-BOGO 50% Off: Pastrami Reuben or Pastram-2026-10-21
item.description: Buy a BIG or Original Pastrami Reuben or Pastrami and Swiss sandwich and get an Original sandwich 50% off, Perks account required, through October 25. (Through October 25, 2026)

item.title: Top Pick: Subway: BOGO 50% Off Footlongs with Code BOGO50
item.guid: Subway-BOGO 50% Off Footlongs with Code BOGO50-2026-10-21
item.description: Buy one footlong online or in the Subway app and get a second 50% off with code BOGO50 at participating locations. Listed by The Krazy Coupon Lady on October 2, 2026; the code has run since summer and may end without notice, so enter it before paying. (Limited time)

item.title: Kroger: Sushi Wednesday: Snowfox Promo Rolls for $6
item.guid: Kroger-Sushi Wednesday: Snowfox Promo Rolls for-2026-10-21
item.description: Every Wednesday, Kroger-family stores with a Snowfox sushi counter (Kroger, Fry's, King Soopers and other banners) sell the Wednesday Only promo lineup, including spicy tuna, Philly, California and veggie rolls, for $6 a roll (up from $5 in 2025) versus $8 to $10 the rest of the week. Walk in; a free Kroger Plus card may be needed for the promo price. (Select states only) (Wednesdays only)

item.title: Publix: $5 Sushi Wednesday: Select Fresh Rolls for $5
item.guid: Publix-$5 Sushi Wednesday: Select Fresh Rolls f-2026-10-21
item.description: Every Wednesday at Publix stores with a sushi counter, select fresh-made rolls (spicy tuna, California, spicy shrimp, cream cheese/Philadelphia-style, vegetable and more; selection varies by store) are $5 each instead of the usual $6 to $10. Walk in and grab them from the sushi case: no app, coupon, or membership needed, while supplies last. (FL & Southeast only) (Wednesdays only)

item.title: Rubio's Coastal Grill: 7 Dollar Plus Meal Menu: Meals from $7 to $10
item.guid: Rubio's Coastal Grill-7 Dollar Plus Meal Menu: Meals from $7 t-2026-10-21
item.description: Rubio's everyday value menu features meals from $7 to $10, including the Fish and Chips for $7.99. (CA, AZ & NV only) (Ongoing)

item.title: El Pollo Loco: Fire-Grilled Combos from $5.99: Pollo Bowl, Chicken Burrito or 3 Tacos al Carbon with Chips and a Drink
item.guid: El Pollo Loco-Fire-Grilled Combos from $5.99: Pollo Bo-2026-10-21
item.description: El Pollo Loco's value combos (Original Pollo Bowl, Classic Chicken Burrito, 3 Tacos al Carbon) come with chips and a regular drink for $5.99 to $6.99 at a Los Angeles store on order.elpolloloco.com, checked October 3, 2026. The chain advertised them at $5 through 2022; prices vary by market. (West & Southwest only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Publix: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
item.guid: Publix-Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's -2026-10-21
item.description: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it. (FL & Southeast only) (Ongoing (changes weekly))

item.title: Naf Naf Grill: $9.99 Pita Meal Deal
item.guid: Naf Naf Grill-$9.99 Pita Meal Deal-2026-10-21
item.description: Naf Naf Grill's value menu: a full pita meal for $9.99, in store and in the app, every day at participating locations. (Midwest & East only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Sprouts: Sushi Wednesday: Select Oumi Rolls for $6
item.guid: Sprouts-Sushi Wednesday: Select Oumi Rolls for $-2026-10-21
